datasheet_identity.title: US2AB THRU US2MB SURFACE MOUNT HIGH EFFICIENT RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as 6a13f492beee87b5b59ca9c41ac9dc9f86ed336d3a732a3b0806207f1225be98 before extraction.
The supplied datasheet covers US2AB through US2MB; the US2MB column was used for tabulated specifications. Manufacturer attribution is Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd.

Fig. 3 was digitized from the dotted US2JB-US2MB family curve, not synthesized from tabulated values. Fig. 4 was digitized from the family-level typical reverse curves at Tj = 25 degC and 125 degC; plotted reverse current is a positive magnitude.
The Fig. 4 x-axis is normalized percent of rated peak reverse voltage. For US2MB, VRRM and VDC are both 1000 V, so 100% corresponds to 1000 V reverse bias.
VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 2.0 A, and IFSM = 50.0 A at 8.3 ms half-sine are maximum ratings from p. 1; they are not substituted for typical electrical-characteristic points.
The separate IR2 limit is 200 microampere at VR = VDC and TA = 100 degC. The 25 degC IR1 maximum of 2 microampere was retained as the reverse_current specification.

Tabulated capacitance 50 pF was converted to 5e-11 F, and tabulated reverse recovery time 75 ns was converted to 7.5e-8 s. No breakdown voltage or breakdown-current specification is published; VRRM is only a maximum rating.
